newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Henkel eyes stronger 1997 results.
newsitem.headline: German Henkel eyes stronger 1997 results.

text.p: German specialty chemicals and consumer goods group Henkel KGaA on Tuesday forecast strong full year results after several high-profile acquisitions last year helped fuel first quarter business.

The Duesseldorf-based group, best known for its Persil washing powder, posted a seven percent rise in group pre-tax profit to 196 million marks while sales sales jumped nearly 20 percent to 4.7 billion marks.
In a statement, the group said: "We are optimistic that we will be able to achieve our sales and results goals for the full year."
The group added that this largely depended on synergy effects with the takeover of U.S. adhesives group Loctite.

Henkel, which has fallen victim to a prolonged slump in domestic consumer demand, said it also expected Europe's consumer goods market to stabilise while overproportional growth in the Asia-Pacific region is expected to continue.
